author: rozaru
body:
@pgaudet 
I was looking at the annotation of fly pr (P48611) and it has an IBA for mitochondrion. The experimental source is human Q03393. The evidence is from a screen deposited to a database LIFE. I followed the link in the [GO page ](https://geneontology.org/GO_REF/0000054.html) but I can’t find the database.
Shouldn’t the screen have an HDA instead of an IDA?
I thought that screens couldn’t be used to make IBA.

I am not convinced that the main location of this protein is mitochondrial as it is the second step in the synthesis of the BH4 cofactor that occurs in the cytosol.
title: Annotation with GO_REF:0000054 from LIFE
